def intake_directory_alias_descriptor(path):
    """Only two pinned flat fixture targets; never generic link traversal."""
    path = Path(path)
    assert str(path) in _INTAKE_DIRECTORY_ALIAS_REGISTRY, ('Unregistered directory alias', str(path))
    record = _INTAKE_DIRECTORY_ALIAS_REGISTRY[str(path)]
    assert path.is_symlink() and path.is_dir()
    assert os.readlink(path) == record['raw_target']
    target = path.resolve(strict=True)
    assert str(target) == record['resolved_directory'] == record['raw_target']
    assert not target.is_symlink() and target.is_dir()
    assert all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (target, *target.parents))
    link_stat = path.lstat(); target_stat = target.stat()
    assert {'device': link_stat.st_dev, 'inode': link_stat.st_ino} == record['link_identity']
    assert {'device': target_stat.st_dev, 'inode': target_stat.st_ino} == record['directory_identity']
    children = sorted(target.iterdir(), key=str)
    assert [p.name for p in children] == ['payload.txt']
    child = children[0]
    assert child.is_file() and not child.is_symlink()
    before = child.stat(); raw = child.read_bytes(); after = child.stat()
    keys = ('st_dev', 'st_ino', 'st_size', 'st_mtime_ns', 'st_ctime_ns')
    assert all(getattr(before, k) == getattr(after, k) for k in keys)
    members = [dict(relative='payload.txt', bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())]
    assert members == record['members']
    logical = path/'payload.txt'
    assert logical.resolve(strict=True) == child and logical.read_bytes() == raw
    assert os.readlink(path) == record['raw_target'] and path.resolve(strict=True) == target
    assert (path.lstat().st_dev, path.lstat().st_ino) == (link_stat.st_dev, link_stat.st_ino)
    assert (target.stat().st_dev, target.stat().st_ino) == (target_stat.st_dev, target_stat.st_ino)
    assert sorted(p.name for p in target.iterdir()) == ['payload.txt']
    return dict(record, logical_children=[str(logical)])


def directory_alias_descriptors():
    assert len(_INTAKE_DIRECTORY_ALIAS_REGISTRY) == 2
    return [intake_directory_alias_descriptor(path) for path in sorted(_INTAKE_DIRECTORY_ALIAS_REGISTRY)]


def strict_intake_paths(root):
    """Full ordinary traversal plus the exact registered logical child aliases."""
    root = Path(root)
    assert root.is_absolute() and root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink()
    found = []
    def visit(directory, ancestors):
        resolved = directory.resolve(strict=True)
        assert str(resolved) not in ancestors, ('Directory cycle', str(directory))
        assert resolved.is_relative_to(root.resolve(strict=True)), ('Directory escape', str(directory))
        ancestors = ancestors | {str(resolved)}
        for path in sorted(directory.iterdir(), key=str):
            assert not (path.is_symlink() and not path.exists()), ('Broken symlink', str(path))
            if path.is_symlink() and path.is_dir():
                record = intake_directory_alias_descriptor(path)
                assert record['resolved_directory'] not in ancestors, ('Directory alias cycle', str(path))
                found.extend(record['logical_children'])
            elif path.is_file():
                found.append(str(path))
            else:
                assert path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink(), ('Unsupported entry', str(path))
                visit(path, ancestors)
    visit(root, set())
    assert len(found) == len(set(found))
    return sorted(found)
